AddFaces.description_en: Adds a face image to an individual for retrieval. The individual must be created in advance
AddFaces.description_zh: 向个体中增加人脸图片，用于检索，需要提前创建个体

AddGroups.description_en: Adds an individual to a specified group. You must specify a group when retrieving an individual
AddGroups.description_zh: 将一个个体添加到一个指定的分组中，检索个体时必须指定分组

AddPerson.description_en: Creates an individual with optional properties such as name and ID
AddPerson.description_zh: 创建一个个体，个体有姓名、id等可选属性

AddSimilarityImage.description_en: Adds one or more images to an image library for retrieval
AddSimilarityImage.description_zh: 向一个图库中添加一张或者多张图像用于检索

AddSimilarityLibrary.description_en: Creates one or more image libraries under an account (UID) for image retrieval
AddSimilarityLibrary.description_zh: 一个账号（uid）下可以创建一个或者多个相似图库，用于检索图像

DeleteFaces.description_en: Deletes one or more face images of a specified individual from an individual library
DeleteFaces.description_zh: 从一个个体库中删除一张或者多张指定个体对应的人脸图片

DeleteGroups.description_en: Deletes one or more individual groups
DeleteGroups.description_zh: 删除一个或者多个个体分组

DeletePerson.description_en: Deletes one or more individuals from an individual library
DeletePerson.description_zh: 从一个个体库中删除一个或者多个个体

DeleteSimilarityImage.description_en: Deletes one or more images from a similar image library
DeleteSimilarityImage.description_zh: 删除相似图库中的一张或者多张图片

DeleteSimilarityLibrary.description_en: Deletes one or more image libraries from an account
DeleteSimilarityLibrary.description_zh: 删除一个账号下的一个或者多个相似图库

DetectFace.description_en: Detects attribute content of a specified face image (such as whether the person is smiling or wearing glasses)
DetectFace.description_zh: 检测一个指定人脸图像的属性内容（比如是否微笑、是否戴眼镜）

FileAsyncScan.description_en: Asynchronously detects risky content in document files such as PDF and Word files
FileAsyncScan.description_zh: 异步检测pdf、word等文档文件中的风险内容

FileAsyncScanResults.description_en: Queries the detection results of asynchronous file scanning
FileAsyncScanResults.description_zh: 查询异步文件扫描的检测结果

FileAsyncScanV2.description_en: Detects content in files of the new version. Supports common office document formats
FileAsyncScanV2.description_zh: 文件检测新版本。支持常见的office文档格式

GetFaces.description_en: The individual name, associated face image IDs, and group IDs to which the individual belongs
GetFaces.description_zh: 个体名称、关联的人脸图片ID和所属个体组ID等

GetGroups.description_en: Retrieves all group information for individuals under an account
GetGroups.description_zh: 获取一个账号下的所有个体分组信息

GetPerson.description_en: Retrieves the property information of a specified individual
GetPerson.description_zh: 获取指定个体的属性信息

GetPersons.description_en: Retrieves individual information from a specified individual group
GetPersons.description_zh: 获取指定个体分组中的个体信息

GetSimilarityImage.description_en: Queries the metadata of sample images in a specified similar image library
GetSimilarityImage.description_zh: 查询指定相似图库中样本图片的元信息

GetSimilarityLibrary.description_en: Queries the information about all image libraries under an account
GetSimilarityLibrary.description_zh: 查询一个账号下的所有图库信息

ImageAsyncManualScan.description_en: Submits an image manual review request
ImageAsyncManualScan.description_zh: 提交图像人工审核请求

ImageAsyncManualScanResults.description_en: Retrieves the manual review results of an image
ImageAsyncManualScanResults.description_zh: 获取图片人工审核结果

ImageAsyncScan.description_en: Identifies multiple risk scenarios in images, including pornography, terrorism-related sensitive content, text, faces, advertisements, and QR codes
ImageAsyncScan.description_zh: 对图片进行多个风险场景的识别，包括色情、暴恐敏感、文字、人脸、广告、二维码识别

ImageAsyncScanResults.description_en: Retrieves the results of asynchronous image detection
ImageAsyncScanResults.description_zh: 获取异步图片检测结果

ImageScanFeedback.description_en: Reports images that are inaccurately identified by the machine
ImageScanFeedback.description_zh: 反馈机器识别不准确的图像

ImageSyncScan.description_en: Detects whether an image contains risky content
ImageSyncScan.description_zh: 检测图片中是否包含风险内容

ListSimilarityImages.description_en: Queries all image samples and their metadata in a specified image library
ListSimilarityImages.description_zh: 查询指定图库下的所有图片样本及其元信息

ListSimilarityLibraries.description_en: Queries all image libraries and their metadata under an account
ListSimilarityLibraries.description_zh: 查询一个账号下所有相似图库及其元信息

LiveStreamAsyncScan.description_en: Submits an asynchronous detection request for a live stream to detect risky content in the live stream
LiveStreamAsyncScan.description_zh: 提交直播流异步检测请求，检测直播中的风险内容

LiveStreamAsyncScanResults.description_en: Retrieves the asynchronous scan results of a live stream
LiveStreamAsyncScanResults.description_zh: 获取直播流异步检测结果

LiveStreamCancelScan.description_en: Cancels a live stream moderation task that is in progress
LiveStreamCancelScan.description_zh: 取消正在检测的直播流任务

SetPerson.description_en: Sets information such as the name and ID of an individual
SetPerson.description_zh: 设置个体的姓名、id等信息

TextAsyncManualScan.description_en: Submits an asynchronous manual review request for text content
TextAsyncManualScan.description_zh: 提交文本异步人工审核请求

TextAsyncManualScanResults.description_en: Retrieves the result of manual text review. The result is returned in JSON format
TextAsyncManualScanResults.description_zh: 获取文本人工审核结果，结果以json形式返回

TextFeedback.description_en: Provides feedback on text content that was inaccurately identified by the machine
TextFeedback.description_zh: 反馈机器识别不准确的文本内容

TextScan.description_en: Detects spam and keywords in text
TextScan.description_zh: 文本垃圾检测和文本关键词检测

UploadCredentials.description_en: Generates an upload credential before uploading a file
UploadCredentials.description_zh: 文件上传前需要生成上传凭证

VideoAsyncManualScan.description_en: Submits an asynchronous manual review request for a video file
VideoAsyncManualScan.description_zh: 提交异步视频文件人工审核请求

VideoAsyncManualScanResults.description_en: Retrieves the manual review result of a video file. The result is returned in JSON format
VideoAsyncManualScanResults.description_zh: 获取视频文件的人工审核结果，结果以json形式返回

VideoAsyncScan.description_en: Submits an asynchronous risk detection request for a video file
VideoAsyncScan.description_zh: 提交视频文件异步风险检测请求

VideoAsyncScanResults.description_en: Retrieves the manual review result of a video file. The result is returned in JSON format
VideoAsyncScanResults.description_zh: 获取视频文件的人工审核结果，结果以json形式返回

VideoFeedback.description_en: Provides feedback on inaccurate machine recognition results for video information
VideoFeedback.description_zh: 反馈机器识别不准确的视频信息

VideoSyncScan.description_en: Detects whether a video contains risky content
VideoSyncScan.description_zh: 检测视频中是否含有风险内容

VodAsyncScan.description_en: Detects whether on-demand videos contain risky content
VodAsyncScan.description_zh: 检测点播视频中是否含有风险内容

VodAsyncScanResults.description_en: Retrieves the asynchronous scan results of on-demand videos
VodAsyncScanResults.description_zh: 获取点播视频异步扫描结果

VoiceAsyncManualScan.description_en: Submits an audio file to the Content Moderation service for manual review. The results must be retrieved asynchronously
VoiceAsyncManualScan.description_zh: 提交语音文件到内容安全服务进行人工审核，结果需要异步获取

VoiceAsyncManualScanResults.description_en: Queries the results of manual voice review. The results are returned in JSON format
VoiceAsyncManualScanResults.description_zh: 查询语音人工审核的结果，结果以json格式返回

VoiceAsyncScan.description_en: Submits an asynchronous speech moderation task to detect risks in audio files or audio streams
VoiceAsyncScan.description_zh: 提交语音异步检测任务，检测语音文件或者语音流中的风险

VoiceAsyncScanResults.description_en: Queries the detection results of a voice stream or voice file
VoiceAsyncScanResults.description_zh: 查询语音流或语音文件的检测结果

VoiceCancelScan.description_en: Cancels a submitted audio detection task that is currently being processed
VoiceCancelScan.description_zh: 取消已经提交并正在检测中的语音检测任务

VoiceIdentityCheck.description_en: Sets the status of manual voice review
VoiceIdentityCheck.description_zh: 设置语音人工审核状态

VoiceIdentityRegister.description_en: Creates a voice individual recognition entry

VoiceIdentityStartCheck.description_en: Sets the entity speech recognition algorithm
VoiceIdentityStartCheck.description_zh: 设置实体语音识别算法

VoiceIdentityStartRegister.description_en: Starts the entity speech recognition algorithm
VoiceIdentityStartRegister.description_zh: 启动实体语音识别算法

VoiceSyncScan.description_en: Detects spam in real-time audio streams or audio files
VoiceSyncScan.description_zh: 检测实时语音流或语音文件中的垃圾内容

WebpageAsyncScan.description_en: Submits an asynchronous risk scan request for an HTML web page. The results must be retrieved asynchronously
WebpageAsyncScan.description_zh: 提交HTML网页的异步风险扫描请求，结果需要异步获取

WebpageAsyncScanResults.description_en: Queries the risk detection results of an HTML page. The results are returned in JSON format
WebpageAsyncScanResults.description_zh: 查询HTML页面的风险检测结果，结果以json格式返回

WebpageSyncScan.description_en: Synchronously detects content risks in an HTML page
WebpageSyncScan.description_zh: 同步检测html页面中的内容风险
